description: Figure 6 illustrates the proportion of harmful responses exhibiting a rejection tendency across different models. The x-axis is labeled “Step” and has a linear scale ranging from 128 to 1024, with tick labels at intervals of 256. The y-axis is labeled “Harmful with Rejection Ratio” and has a linear scale ranging from 0.0 to 0.75, with tick labels at intervals of 0.1. Four lines are present in the plot. A solid red line, representing LLaVA-1.5-7B on FigStep, begins at approximately 0.18 at x=128 and ends at approximately 0.21 at x=1024, showing a generally steady trend. A solid green line, representing Qwen2-VL-7B on FigStep, starts at approximately 0.16 at x=128 and increases to approximately 0.31 at x=1024. A solid blue line, representing LLaVA-1.5-7B on MMSafetyBench, begins at approximately 0.15 at x=128 and ends at approximately 0.18 at x=1024, also showing a generally steady trend. Finally, a dashed orange line, representing Qwen2-VL-7B on MMSafetyBench, starts at approximately 0.14 at x=128 and increases to approximately 0.28 at x=1024.
